query: Male, 75, with heart failure: among male ICU patients 70–80 with heart failure, what is diagnostic intensity in first 72 ICU hours (mean, median, 75th and 95th percentiles)? Compare to general ICU population; report mean ICU LOS and hospital mortality.
final_sql:
APPROX_QUANTILES(total_events, 10000)[OFFSET(7500)] AS target_75th_diagnostic_events
   APPROX_QUANTILES(total_events, 10000)[OFFSET(9500)] AS target_95th_diagnostic_events;
